_comment: Example hooks for Claude Code. Copy what you want into your ~/.claude/settings.json under the 'hooks' key. Every hook here is opt-in — uncomment and adapt to your stack. The principles: stay quiet on the success path, write to stderr only when there's something the user should know, and never block unless the situation is truly destructive.

PreToolUse._purpose: Suggest tmux for long-running commands so the user can detach/reattach.
PreToolUse.matcher: tool == "Bash" && tool_input.command matches "(npm run dev|pnpm dev|yarn dev|cargo run|python -m http.server|next dev)"

hooks.command: if [ -z "$TMUX" ]; then echo '[hint] long-running command — consider tmux for session persistence' >&2; fi

PreToolUse._purpose: Open editor for review before git push (catches accidental pushes of broken state).

hooks.command: echo '[review] About to push. Last 3 commits:' >&2; git log -3 --oneline >&2

PreToolUse._purpose: Block writing arbitrary new .md files at repo root (clutter prevention).

hooks.command: echo '[block] Refusing to create new top-level .md files. Put docs in docs/ or alongside code.' >&2; exit 2

PostToolUse._purpose: Format on save for TypeScript/JavaScript files. Adapt to your formatter.
Quick typecheck on TypeScript edits — fails loudly if types broke.
Warn on console.log in production paths.

hooks.command: if grep -nE 'console\\.(log|warn|error|info|debug)' "$file_path" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[warn] $file_path contains console.* — remove before committing" >&2; fi

PreCompact._purpose: Save important state before context compaction. Edit the script path to your needs.

Stop._purpose: Warn if any modified file still contains console.log at end of response.

hooks.command: git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM 2>/dev/null | xargs -I{} grep -lE 'console\\.(log|warn|error|info|debug)' {} 2>/dev/null | head -5 | while read f; do echo "[stop] $f still has console.* — clean up before committing" >&2; done

SessionStart._purpose: Show the most recent session memory file, if one exists. Loads into Claude's view of the workspace.

hooks.command: latest=$(ls -t .claude/sessions/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -1); if [ -n "$latest" ]; then echo "[session] Most recent session memory: $latest" >&2; fi
